github.name: coolify
github.description: An open-source, self-hostable PaaS alternative to Vercel, Heroku & Netlify that lets you easily deploy static sites, databases, full-stack applications and 360+ one-click services on your own servers.

readme.excerpt: What is Coolify? Coolify is an open-source, self-hostable platform for deploying any application, database, or service on your own servers. It is an alternative to Heroku, Netlify, and Vercel. It gives you the experience of a managed cloud platform while running on infrastructure you control. This could be a VPS, a bare-metal server, a Raspberry Pi, or even an old laptop running Linux. You only need an SSH connection. Your configurations stay on your servers. If you stop using Coolify, your running resources continue to work and remain manageable. Coolify is fully free and open source, as described in our philosophy, with an optional managed service, Coolify Cloud. Nothing is locked behind a paywall. Screenshots Dashboard: projects and servers at a glance Application configuration: deploy and configure any application Domains: custom domains with automatic HTTPS Server metrics: real-time CPU and memory monitoring Notifications: alerts via Discord, Telegram, Slack, and more Key features Area Highlights :--- :--- Deploy Any stack from GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Gitea or a Docker image, via Railpack, Dockerfile or Compose, with auto-deploy, PR previews, webhooks, rolling updates & rollbacks Databases & services Deploy Postgres, MongoDB, Redis & more, plus 360+ one-click services Networking Reverse proxy with automatic HTTPS, custom domains & isolated Docker networks Servers Manage
